prompt: How do I upgrade a user's subscription from Basic to Pro mid-cycle in Stripe?
expected: Load billing. Point to Update Subscription and require an explicit proration_behavior (create_prorations for standard upgrades; none for deferred downgrades; always_invoice when immediate invoice is required). Do not rely on an omitted PSP default.
actual: Loaded billing + references/domain.md and sources for prorations. Recommended subscriptions.update with proration_behavior=create_prorations for a standard Basic→Pro upgrade so unused Basic time is credited and Pro is charged on the next invoice. Noted none vs always_invoice as explicit alternatives. Did not invent amounts or tax rates.

prompt: A customer requested immediate cancellation and deletion of their account. Should I use subscription.delete() or cancel_at_period_end: true?
expected: Advise subscription.delete() (or equivalent immediate cancel) because the customer asked for immediate deletion; explain cancel_at_period_end is the default revenue-preserving churn path when access may continue until period end. Mention refund policy as a separate decision.
actual: Distinguished cancel_at_period_end (access through period_end, no renewal) from immediate delete. Because the customer requested immediate account deletion, recommended subscription.delete()/immediate cancel rather than period-end cancel. Flagged prorated refund as policy-dependent. Kept PCI/token data out of examples.

prompt: Our webhook handler parses JSON first, then checks Stripe-Signature, and grants access on invoice.paid without storing event ids. What should we fix?
expected: Require signature verification on the raw body before parse, idempotency via event_id, and access grants that tolerate out-of-order subscription.updated vs invoice.paid (eventual consistency / status+period checks).
actual: Called out three defects: verify Stripe-Signature on raw body before JSON parse; persist event_id and short-circuit duplicates; do not assume invoice.paid ordering—re-read subscription status and period before granting access. Pointed to references/webhooks.md and domain race-condition rule.
